summary: Backend + frontend verification of onboarding redesign (intro → formats → topics) and new 3D category media (glossy-3d-v4). All 6 backend tests pass. All specified UI flows work: intro CTA, no back button on modes, 3-dot pager with correct active index, mode-cards expand explanations only when selected, hint returns when both untapped, mode chips in phase 2 with cannot-deselect-last-one behavior, dynamic topics hint text updates per selected formats (curiosities / mini lessons / both), 12-tile grid + chip-all, CTA disabled without category, dot-based back navigation preserves state, and full completion navigates to /discover with real category imagery (blue paw for Animali, books stack for Mini lezioni pill, star for 'Any topic' banner). No horizontal overflow at 320px. No JS runtime errors from app code (only pre-existing Reanimated easing warnings on web and Metro dev-socket transient 502s that don't affect the flow).
action_items: Optional: stale legacy suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter24_category_media.py still asserts 13 categories including 'curiosita' and prefix 'pause/category/glass-2026-09-v1/'; after the curiosita migration to glossy-3d-v4 that file is guaranteed to fail if run. Consider removing or updating it so future regression runs stay green. Not run in this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.tsx: the pager back-nav uses `i < step && goTo(i)` so tapping the currently-active dot (or any forward dot) is correctly a no-op. State (selected topics + modes) is preserved across step changes as required.

onboarding-intro.tsx defines a container with testID='onboarding-dots' (three static decorative markers) that collides with the PagerDots testID='onboarding-dots' used on step 1/2. It didn't cause test failures because the intro screen is a different route render, but two components sharing the same testID is a latent test/accessibility smell — consider renaming the intro one to 'onboarding-intro-dots' (its children already use 'onboarding-intro-dot-{i}').

Two 502 responses appeared in console during navigation; they came from Metro dev socket, not the API. All /api/user/interests and /api/user/content-modes calls returned 200 with expected persisted payload.
seed_data_creation: None. Verified with anonymous session; onboarding creates a UID via getOrCreateUserId and POSTs to /api/user/interests and /api/user/content-modes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding flow reachable at /onboarding after clearing localStorage. Backend serves 12 categories under manifest prefix 'pause/category/glossy-3d-v4/'; endpoint /api/category-media/{id} returns image/webp for base and image/png for cutout variants. TTS and Stripe intentionally disabled (503) — do not test. Legacy test_iter24 file is out of date; keep it out of the run.
